idea.title: Freelancer Pro Suite — unified CRM invoices tax proposals CLI

plan.tagline: All-in-one CLI toolkit — CRM, invoices, tax, proposals in one command
plan.problem: Freelancers waste time switching between CRM, invoicing, tax tools, and proposal generators, losing track of clients and payments.
plan.solution: A single CLI tool that unifies client management, invoicing, tax estimation, and proposal generation with minimal friction.
plan.target_market: Solo freelancers and small agencies (2-5 people) in SE Asia who prefer terminal workflows and need to streamline operations.
mvp_features: Add/list clients with contact details and interaction history
Create invoices with automatic reminders and overdue alerts
Log income and get quarterly tax estimates with breakdowns
Generate proposals from templates using client/project details
Dashboard showing active clients, invoices, tax status, and reminders

build_phases.name: Core DB & CLI
build_phases.description: Unified SQLite DB schema for clients, invoices, income, proposals + basic add/list commands

build_phases.name: Smart Automation
build_phases.description: Overdue invoice alerts, tax estimation engine, proposal template engine

build_phases.name: Demo & Polish
build_phases.description: --demo workflow + formatted dashboard output + help docs

plan.demo_script: python main.py --demo: adds client → creates invoice → logs income → generates proposal → shows dashboard with all data
plan.phuket_angle: Ideal for Phuket-based freelancers (e.g., villa managers, tour guides) managing international clients with simple tax needs.
